question: Which chemical compound is used as a bleaching agent in some foods such as wheat flour, edible oil, egg white etc.?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Hydrogen peroxide".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hydrogen peroxide** is an **oxidizing **agent and is significantly used for bleaching purposes.
 
• Due to its **oxidizing** property, it oxidizes the** thiol **companies of **enzymes** and **proteins** inflicting metabolic inhibition on microbes.
